description:
EU Law OCR Dataset PL 100

This dataset is designed as a lightweight sample for:

document AI / VLM experiments

author: Lukaszl
description:
OCR Bench Results: Polish EU law and legal documents benchmark
	

VLM-as-judge pairwise evaluation of OCR models on Polish EU law and legal-style documents. Results depend strongly on document type, so this should be read as a document-specific benchmark rather than a universal OCR ranking.
This benchmark focuses on dense Polish legal text derived from EU law materials, including multi-paragraph pages with small fonts, numbered sections, formal structure, references, and list-heavy… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lukaszl/eu-law-ocr-dataset-pl-100-v1-results.

author: endomorphosis
description:
EUR-Lex In-Force EU Legislation (CELLAR)
	

Research snapshot of in-force European Union legal acts collected from
EUR-Lex via the Publications Office CELLAR
SPARQL endpoint and CELLAR REST manifestation item URLs. English expression
is primary. CELEX sector 3 (regulations, directives, decisions, and
related acts still in force) plus sector 1 treaty/protocol works marked
in force. Not case law (ECLI / sector 6). Original OJ/CELLAR expressions
(not CELEX sector 0 consolidations).… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/endomorphosis/ipfs_eu_laws.
